Senses.Explanation: A monastery administrator is one of the officers who conduct the community’s practical and institutional business. Rulebooks list the office among communal posts; records address the administrators collectively, assign them duties, thank incoming and outgoing officeholders, and narrate dealings with them. The title names administration rather than the presiding teaching office.
